title: Memory
core_thesis: Spatial memory in physical AI is an active, decaying epistemic belief rather than static storage; state coordinates must be bound to their acquisition epoch and physical error limits to prevent controllers from acting on dangerous geometric fiction.
pedagogical_strengths: Effectively grounds abstract state estimation in tangible physical consequences, using tolerance exhaustion to define physical state expiry.
The 'Midpoint Fallacy' callout vividly highlights the danger of blind statistical fusion when physical sensors disagree.

student_friction_points.point: The transition from discrete SE(3) kinematic frames to continuous volumetric voxel hierarchies is abrupt. An intuitive pedagogical bridge connecting these two spatial abstractions is needed before introducing OctoMaps.
The text dictates that states carry 'hardware lineage' and 'epoch' across buses, but the systems-level implementation of these metadata payloads remains ungrounded for system architects.

established_budgets_and_laws: Physical state expiry calculated via unobserved error envelope crossing mechanical tolerance limits (1/2 * a_dist * Δt^2).
Temporal skew error budget in relative motion (Δx = v_rel * Δt).
imported_prerequisites: Causal boundaries and nanosecond-precise energy transduction epochs (@sec-boundary-causal-boundary).
Actuator thermal limits and kinetic momentum constraints (@sec-body-kinetic-momentum).
exported_concepts: Forensic recording of expired spatial transforms for authority logs (@sec-intervention-authority-log).
Chi-squared innovation gating to prevent hallucinated midpoints in downstream sensor fusion.

surgical_edits.target_text: A belief passed across a bus or retrieved from a buffer cannot be a raw array of floating-point numbers; it embodies the system's interpretation of sensory inputs and must maintain data integrity during transfer.
surgical_edits.improved_text: A belief passed across a real-time bus cannot be a naked array of floating-point numbers. It embodies a decaying interpretation of physical inputs and must explicitly carry its epoch, physical uncertainty, and reference frame to remain valid.

surgical_edits.target_text: Calling a kinematic predictor twenty times in succession without a fresh measurement does not refresh the memory of the machine. It merely inflates the spatial variance envelope—the mathematical "blur" representing all the places the tool might physically be—according to the physical limits of unmodeled acceleration.
surgical_edits.improved_text: Calling a kinematic predictor repeatedly without fresh measurements cannot refresh the machine's memory. It merely inflates the spatial variance envelope—the mathematical "blur" defining where the tool might physically reside—driven strictly by the limits of unmodeled acceleration.

open_thematic_threads_for_part: How do planners and execution engines dynamically adapt or initiate controlled stops when spatial memory explicitly expires mid-maneuver?
